heuristics: H1: the canonical walk's generic states have uniform independent indices (x mod 32) and non-forced parities; the same heuristic yields the classical 1/64 negation 2-cycle rate (reproduced exactly by the census enumeration and by the toy's distance-2 escape rate) and the birthday model.

The cycle-family analysis is exact GIVEN H1: families are (word, sign-pattern) pairs with per-symbol even multiplicity over the constants [2^j]P; the composed map returns C iff prod kappa = +1 and the per-symbol inclusive-suffix products balance - an exact integer relation since any signed sum of <= 16 constants satisfies |sum| <= 16*2^31 < r (verified in Part A); kappa <-> suffix is a bijection giving exactly prod_s C(2 t_s, t_s)/2 solutions per word; in a genuine family (no prefix closure) every kappa except the last is a free parity event, so rate_L = families(L) * 64^-(L-1) exactly; the census executes at production parameters (1, 157, 46,844 for L = 2, 4, 6) with conservative partition-sum bounds 2^-13.19 (L = 8..16) and 2^-23.25 (L >= 18, ratchet-fenced trapped waste 2^-13.25).

Efficiency charge 0.85: below the toy-measured 0.903 (91/200 = 0.455 vs the same-parameters ideal 0.504), consistent with Teske's r-adding-walk analysis for r = 32, charged in the conservative direction; the claim survives an efficiency charge of 0.80 (0.4032).
limitations: Analytic construction; no production-size execution is claimed or possible.
